details: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) has approved the trading of perpetual futures tied to individual stocks on regulated U.S. exchanges for the first time. This marks a significant development as perpetual futures are a staple in crypto trading, offering U.S. traders a regulated alternative to often unregulated offshore venues.
title: US CFTC Clears Individual Stock Perpetual Futures Trading

details: Solana's (SOL) price has dropped to a 7-month low, trading around $93, after experiencing record U.S. spot ETF outflows totaling $71.47 million in the most recent week. This marks the largest weekly outflow since these products launched. Additionally, on-chain data indicates large wallets (whales) are moving SOL to exchanges, suggesting selling pressure, unlike Ethereum where whales are reportedly buying the dip.
title: Solana (SOL) Price Hits 7-Month Low Due to Massive Outflows

details: Ethereum (ETH) has shown a rebound in price, rising 1.8% in the last 24 hours to around $2,290, despite U.S. spot Ethereum ETFs recording six consecutive days of net outflows, totaling $139.8 million on Monday alone. Bloomberg analyst James Seyffart noted that Ethereum ETF holders are sitting on unrealized losses of nearly $3.5 billion, with an average cost basis just under $3,200 per token.
title: ETH Price Recovers as ETF Holders Face Billions in Losses

details: The XRP Ledger is targeting a November 4th implementation of a fix for a newly discovered flaw. This vulnerability could have allowed delegate accounts, authorized only to burn issued tokens, to mint additional stablecoins under certain conditions. While ordinary account holders could not exploit this, the documentation advises issuers against delegating "PaymentBurn" permission until the fix is active. XRP's price was up slightly by 2.6% in the last 24 hours, trading around $1.28, despite this news.
title: XRP Ledger Nears Fix for Stablecoin Minting Vulnerability

details: The Liquid Network has successfully restored full Bitcoin backing following a $320 million exploit. This recovery demonstrates resilience in the face of security breaches within the crypto ecosystem.
title: Liquid Network Restores Full Bitcoin Backing Post-$320M Exploit

details: Binance has completed its latest proof of reserves as the exchange works to restore assets and withdrawals following a recent record-breaking hack. This move is part of an effort to restore user confidence and demonstrate the security of funds.
title: Binance Completes Proof of Reserves Amid Security Concerns

details: Solana developer Anza and the Solana Foundation have issued an urgent warning to validators to immediately secure their servers against a critical Linux vulnerability (CVE-2026-98432). Researchers demonstrated an exploit capable of granting root access to affected Linux servers without credentials, and while the flaw is fixed in the Linux kernel, it remains unpatched in Ubuntu, an OS commonly used by Solana validators.
title: Solana Validators Warned of Critical Linux Vulnerability
